title: Pedagogy for Social Studies Education
description: Curriculum organization, instructional approaches and assessment practices in elementary or middle school social studies. Interdisciplinary examples are drawn from; anthropology, economics, gender studies, geography, history, political science and/or sociology, with emphasis on inquiry learning, community engagement, First Nations' Principles of Learning, participatory citizenship and social justice imperatives in a pluralistic society.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EDCI 414, EDCI 404.
May be offered in English or French.
